text: Sam D. is a great instructor at Brazos Valley Flight Services. He's very straightforward, realistic, and doesn't sugarcoat anything, which I really appreciate as a student pilot. He's especially great for students who are serious and committed to becoming better pilots. Sam has helped me a lot throughout my training, and I'm grateful for the time and guidance he's given me. Highly recommend him to anyone looking for an honest and knowledgeable instructor.

text: Had a checkout flight with Samuel Dvorak. I called about availability and they had me in a plane within a couple hours. Great dude, very knowledgeable and friendly. 10/10 would recommend

Sam Dvorak has been an excellent CFI throughout the process of attaining my PPL. He's got a wellspring of knowledge regarding all the aircraft's at BVFS due to previous mechanical work. Not to mention, his ability to teach is superb; he's extremely patient and very encouraging! I highly recommend y'all to ask for Sam if you want to have an amazing journey in attempting to get any license, certification, or simply want an amazing flight experience.
